bound_interpretation: Worst/best missing-outcome bounds, not confidence intervals.
missingness: INVALIDATED and UNSTARTED final outcomes are unknown. Observed prefixes are retained separately; missing-outcome bounds include every scheduled family.
temporary_failure_definition: A valid attempted candidate fails a property after onset; temporary_joint_failure requires such a joint failure followed by a jointly passing retained endpoint. Invalid attempted programs are separate operational events.
weighting: Equal family within each source and initial-state stratum; no pooled primary effect.
